statement.title: Advancing Bioinformatics Through Computational Innovation
paragraphs: My research develops machine learning methods, bioinformatics tools, and data resources to analyze complex biological systems. I focus on genomics, transcriptomics, and host-pathogen interaction modeling, with an emphasis on building practical tools that are interpretable and reproducible.

I collaborate across disciplines to translate algorithms into accessible web resources and pipelines. My current work at South Dakota State University centers on AI-enabled discovery in agriculture and animal health, integrating multi-omics data to improve prediction and biological understanding.

areas.title: Multi-omics Data Integration
areas.description: Developing computational methods to merge genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, and metabolomics for a systems-level view of biology.

areas.title: AI in Genomics
areas.description: Applying deep learning to predict gene function, regulatory elements, and variant effects with interpretable, robust models.
details: Deep learning models for genomic prediction

areas.title: Systems Biology
areas.description: Modeling biological networks and pathways to uncover mechanism-level insights and identify intervention points.

areas.title: Bioinformatics Tooling
areas.description: Designing databases, web servers, and analysis pipelines that make complex data usable for researchers.

projects.title: deepNEC
projects.description: A deep learning framework for predicting nitrogen metabolism enzymes from protein sequences, providing interpretable insights into sequence-function relationships.

projects.title: pySeqRNA
projects.description: A comprehensive RNA-Seq analysis package with automated QC, alignment, quantification, and differential expression workflows.

projects.title: HuCoPIA
projects.description: An atlas of human-coronavirus protein interactions with network visualization and comparative analyses across Coronaviridae.

projects.title: miPyRNA
projects.description: A Python package for small RNA-seq analysis focused on microRNA identification, quantification, and target prediction.

cta.title: Open to collaborative research and tool development
cta.description: If you are working on genomics, host-pathogen interaction modeling, or AI-driven bioinformatics, I would love to collaborate.
